about: Durable per-team jersey font decisions for the Kinetic Type Engine (brief 15, 23 November 2026). Later songs for a team read this record instead of re-researching jersey lettering from scratch. No song reads this file automatically yet; a song only switches fonts once a font is finished, measured into fonts/*.metrics.json, and wired in song settings.json (jersey_font).

Minnesota Timberwolves.description: Flared pointed tips with a small split spur, as on the Classic Edition Black Trees and 1996–2008 Tree Era backs (GARNETT 21, GOBERT 27, EDWARDS 5).
Minnesota Timberwolves.font_file: pending, being built in ~/Experiments/Timberwolves Classic Pointy Font/

colours.numbers: #FFFFFF (white, no outline — per KIT Type rule 3)

alternates_not_chosen.name: Icon / Association / Statement chamfered sans (2017 to 2026, RARE Design custom)
alternates_not_chosen.characteristics: Condensed sans serif with 45-degree chamfered corners on curved letters (B C D G O R S U), flat squared stroke ends, and a crossbar-less A drawn as Λ (EDWΛRDS). Names white with no outline; numbers white with thin lake-blue outline on real jerseys (plain white under KIT Type rule 3).
alternates_not_chosen.why_not_chosen: Jefferson chose the Classic Edition pointy lettering instead (23 November 2026).
